description: This file defines the PdfCheckBoxField class, representing a checkbox form field within a PDF document. It provides properties and methods to get or set the checked state of the checkbox, manages its appearance states, and handles complex interactions for fields with multiple appearances.

classes.name: PdfCheckBoxField
classes.description: Represents a checkbox form field in a PDF, with functionality to determine and set whether the checkbox is checked, including complex handling for multiple appearance states.

methods.name: Checked
methods.description: Gets or sets the checked state of the checkbox, handling cases with or without 'kids' (child fields) and managing appearance states accordingly.

methods.name: CheckedName
methods.description: Gets or sets the name used in the PDF dictionary to indicate the 'checked' state.

methods.name: UncheckedName
methods.description: Gets or sets the name used in the PDF dictionary to indicate the 'unchecked' state.
